title: Stale Passwords on Critical Accounts
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passwordage:account
| stats count(eval(days_since_rotation>rotation_target_days)) as stale_passwords count as accounts by criticality
| sort 0 - stale_passwords
description: Ranks criticality tierss by stale critical passwords.
value: Critical accounts with stale passwords deserve a queue of their own because the blast radius is different.
implementation: Send stale critical passwords events to `index=personal` and keep `criticality` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of stale critical passwords by criticality tiers.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which criticality tierss stand out most for stale critical passwords.
